name: User - Default (seed v1)
description: A player account (Minecraft, web or both). Accounts are created by the game when a player first joins, or by web sign-up; this form is for staff corrections such as deactivating an account. Balances, ranks, permissions, multipliers, freezes and staff modes have their own actions on the player's admin page.

steps.description: Who the account belongs to. The username and Minecraft UUID come from the game; change them only to correct a mistake.

fields.label: Username
fields.description: The player's Minecraft name, shown in game and on the site. Must be unique across all accounts.

fields.label: Minecraft UUID
fields.description: Set by the game server when the player first joins, and fixed after that. Empty for a web account whose player hasn't joined yet.

fields.label: Email
fields.description: The web login address; empty for a Minecraft-only account. Saving an edit needs one (the API refuses an edit without it), and changing it signs the player out of the web app everywhere.

fields.label: Account active
fields.description: Untick to deactivate the account: the player can't log in to the web app, every session ends, they can't send or receive payments and they drop off leaderboards. Tick again to restore it.

steps.description: Choices that change how the game treats this player. The player can also change the gate method in game.

fields.label: Gender
fields.description: Picks the male or female name of the player's title in chat and menus. Empty = the male name.

fields.label: Gate pass-through
fields.description: What happens when the player right-clicks a closed gate that allows passing through: Default opens the gate for its pass-through time, InstantOpen removes only the blocks in their way (needs knk.gate.passthrough.instant), Teleport puts them on the other side. In game: /knk gate passthrough.

steps.description: For reference only: these are kept as they are when you save. Freeze or unfreeze a player from their admin page or with /freeze in game, which records who did it and why.

fields.label: Created via
fields.description: Where the account was first created: web sign-up or the player's first join on the Minecraft server. Used for statistics and account recovery.

fields.label: Email verified
fields.description: Whether the player has confirmed their email address. Email verification isn't built yet, so this is normally off.

fields.label: Frozen
fields.description: A frozen player can't move, chat, use commands or take damage in game until staff unfreeze them, and can't send payments.

fields.label: Freeze reason
fields.description: The reason staff gave when freezing the player. Empty when the player isn't frozen.
